# Bare Compounding Pharmacy

> A specialized compounding pharmacy in Folsom, California offering personalized bioidentical hormones, custom medications, and innovative veterinary treatments including FIP therapy.

Bare Compounding Pharmacy provides custom pharmaceutical compounding services for human patients, pediatric patients, and veterinary clients. The pharmacy specializes in hormone replacement therapy, weight management medications like Semaglutide, and advanced delivery systems like the TICKER® transdermal applicator, all while maintaining strict USP compliance standards.

## Key Topics

- Bioidentical Hormone Replacement Therapy (BHRT)
- Custom Compounded Medications
- Semaglutide Weight Loss
- GS-441524 (FIP Treatment)
- Veterinary Compounding
- Thyroid Compounds (T3/T4)
- Pediatric Formulations
- TICKER® Transdermal Device
- Low-Dose Naltrexone
- Personalized Medicine
- USP Compliance Standards
- Transdermal Delivery Systems
- Sildenafil & Tadalafil
- Sermorelin
- Pharmacy Services

## Core Services & Specialties

- [Hormone Replacement Therapy](https://barecompounding.com/pages/hormone-replacement-therapy): Bioidentical hormone replacement therapy (BHRT) services and hormone health information
- [Healthy Weight Loss with Semaglutide](https://barecompounding.com/pages/healthy-weight-loss): Semaglutide weight loss treatment and GLP-1 receptor agonist alternatives from Bare Compounding
- [Compounded Thyroid Medication](https://barecompounding.com/pages/thyroid_compound): Personalized compounded thyroid medications (T3/T4) for hypothyroidism treatment
- [What is Compounding?](https://barecompounding.com/pages/personalized-ingredients): Educational guide explaining pharmaceutical compounding and personalized medicine practices
- [Human Medicine Product Catalog](https://barecompounding.com/collections/human-compounds): Product catalog of hormone compounds and topical medications for human medicine

## Veterinary & Specialty Treatments

- [Veterinary Compounding](https://barecompounding.com/pages/veterinary): Custom pet medications and transdermal delivery systems for veterinary patients
- [GS-441524 (FIP Treatment)](https://barecompounding.com/pages/compounded-gs-441524-for-fip): Compounded GS-441524 antiviral treatment for feline infectious peritonitis (FIP)

## Pediatric & Specialty Formulations

- [Pediatrics](https://barecompounding.com/pages/pediatrics): Custom pediatric medications and flavored formulations for children's specific needs
- [Scar Creams](https://barecompounding.com/pages/scar-creams): Silicone-based topical scar cream for surgical, acne, and stretch mark treatment
